name: motion-basic-v1
description: A small starter prompt set for basic motion, camera, and temporal consistency checks.

prompts.text: A red bicycle slowly rolls down a quiet city street at sunrise, camera tracking from the side.
A ceramic cup fills with steaming tea on a wooden table, close-up shot, soft morning light.
A golden retriever catches a blue frisbee in a grassy park, handheld camera, natural motion.
A person in a yellow raincoat walks through shallow puddles at night, reflections on the street.
A small paper boat floats along a narrow stream, overhead camera, gentle water movement.
